falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern match to bottom_2024_aug falls below 50% and SPX closes more than 5% below its verdict-day close within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom analog that justified HOLD has failed; UNKNOWN/HOLD is wrong because price has confirmed a breakdown, not an unresolved bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score rises from 39 to above 70 and SPX prints a new 20-day closing high within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Regime is a melt-up, not an unknown bottom; HOLD is invalidated because the tape has resolved risk-on with blowoff characteristics

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 28 for three consecutive sessions, or HY OAS widens more than 50 bps from the verdict-day level, within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Stress has left the unknown phase; HOLD is wrong because observable vol or credit stress has forced a risk-off resolution

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
